## Où j'en suis
Draft PR #418 is open (still open) on tom/dashboards-grid-v2: a drag/resize widget grid built with react-grid-layout, layout saved per user via PUT /dashboards/:id/layout with a localStorage fallback, behind the dashboards_v2 flag. Widget sizing uses a ResizeObserver hook, since container queries failed on iOS 15. DashboardTile was renamed WidgetCard, lint, typecheck and the Storybook build pass.

- [en-cours] Draft PR #418 awaits Priya's UX review on the iPad.
- [prochaine-étape] Enable dashboards_v2 for the Zest workspace only in the flags admin before the demo on Tuesday 24th.
- [essai-raté] CSS container queries did nothing on Zest's iOS 15 Safari (needs Safari 16+), so they were removed.
- [décision] Use a ResizeObserver hook (data-size) and drop container queries entirely, to avoid two systems (source: t09)
- [décision] Keep v1 dashboards available behind the flag until January; remove nothing now (source: t15)
- [décision] Persist the layout server-side via PUT /dashboards/:id/layout in this PR (source: t03)
